headline: Eleven degrees before the light returns.
body: The temperature has fallen to eleven degrees. A west-southwest breeze holds near seven kilometres an hour; pressure stands at one thousand twenty-eight and holds steady. High cloud covers roughly two-thirds of the sky, and the streets remain dry under the lamps.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: mostly cloudy, 11°C, WSW 7 km/h, pressure 1028 steady
